svg.title: C2B Hakikisha: a request, step by step
svg.desc: Safaricom asks for a token and then for an account name, the service answers from its MongoDB copy, which a scheduled sync keeps fresh.
svg.text: C2B Hakikisha: a request, step by step
what the app asks and who answers

g.text: Basic client credentials ask for a token
short lived, kept by the caller
an account number, the customer phone
answered from the local MongoDB copy
at startup and every 5 minutes, from the wallet service

svg.text: The Flutter app makes the same two calls from the staff tool, with the credentials typed in by the person.
The credentials and the token stay in memory and are gone when the app closes.
